summary: App with model tiers: Free Tier limited to 3 uses of ROM (Annual Tonnage Schedule) inputs before blocking and prompting Premium Tier upgrade. Save/Load model options removed.
architectural_notes: Free Tier enforces a hard limit of 3 ROM (Annual Tonnage Schedule) input uses; after limit is reached, inputs are blocked and a Premium Tier upsell prompt is shown.

existing_features.title: Remove the 'Save' and 'Load' model buttons from the DashboardHeader component. These buttons currently appear in the sticky top navigation header. Remove all UI elements, click handlers, and related modal triggers for both SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal from DashboardHeader.

Remove SaveProjectModal and ProjectListModal from any other locations where they are rendered or triggered (e.g., ProjectContext, DashboardPage, or any other component that exposes Save/Load project functionality).

In the ReservesProductionSection component, track ROM (Annual Tonnage Schedule) usage against the backend counter. When a Free Tier user has used ROM inputs 3 times (romUsageCount >= 3), disable all Annual ROM Tonnage Schedule inputs and display a prominent inline message prompting the user to upgrade to Premium Tier. The message must include a call-to-action that opens the SubscriptionModal. Before reaching the limit, each time the user applies/confirms ROM inputs, increment the backend romUsageCount counter.

Update the ProjectContext to expose romUsageCount from the user profile and provide a helper function to increment it via the backend. This data should be accessible to ReservesProductionSection and any component that needs to check or update ROM usage.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove 'Save' and 'Load' model options from the app
Implement Free Tier limit of 3 uses of ROM (Annual Tonnage Schedule) inputs; block usage after 3 and prompt user to buy Premium Tier

Add a backend counter per user that tracks how many times the ROM (Annual Tonnage Schedule) inputs have been used/submitted. The counter must persist in the user's profile. Free Tier users are allowed a maximum of 3 uses. The backend must expose a method to get the current ROM usage count and a method to increment it, with access control that rejects increments beyond 3 for Free Tier users.
